name: command
purpose: Command Menu is a ⌘K command palette: a modal overlay with a search input and a filtered, keyboard-navigable list of actions. It wraps the `Dialog` primitive for its panel, backdrop, focus trap, scroll-lock, and Escape handling, and adds the palette chrome on top — a search `Input`, a scrollable `List` of `Item`s organized into optional `Group`s, an `Empty` state, and `Separator`s. The root owns open/closed state (controlled or uncontrolled), a global open shortcut (⌘K / Ctrl+K), the substring filter, and roving active-item navigation. It differs from `dropdown` (a small trigger-anchored menu) and `select` (a form value picker): Command Menu is a full-screen search-first launcher for actions, not a positioned menu or an input control.
useWhen: Provide a global ⌘K launcher for navigating to pages or running actions across an app.
Let users filter a large, grouped list of commands by typing, then activate with the keyboard.
avoidWhen: A small menu anchored to a trigger button → use `dropdown`.
Picking a value for a form field → use `select` / `multi-select`.
A confirmation or content modal without search/list semantics → use `dialog` directly.
related: dialog` — the overlay primitive Command Menu wraps for panel, backdrop, focus trap, and Escape.
kbd` — renders each item's keyboard-shortcut hint and the ⌘K affordance.
dropdown` — trigger-anchored menu; reach for it when the list is short and positioned by a trigger.
bestPractices: Write items as Title Case verb phrases describing an action ("Deploy Project"), not navigation labels.
Keep the palette controlled via `v-model:open` so the app can open it from a button and from the global ⌘K shortcut.
Group related actions with `<Command.Group heading="…">` and separate distinct sections with `<Command.Separator>`.

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled open state. Use with `v-model:open` or `@update:open`. When omitted, the palette is uncontrolled.

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: When true, backdrop click and Escape close the palette.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Global `'+'`-delimited keyboard shortcut that toggles the palette open (e.g. `'meta+k'`); matched against Ctrl on non-macOS platforms.

events.name: update:open
events.notes: Fires on every open/closed transition; supports `v-model:open`.

events.name: select
events.notes: Fires when an enabled item is activated (click or `Enter`). `event` is the activation event; `value` is the item's identifier. The palette closes automatically and focus returns to the element that was focused before opening.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The palette content: a `<Command.Input>` followed by a `<Command.List>`. Rendered inside the teleported dialog panel.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CommandGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/command-group'
  import CommandInput from '@aziontech/webkit/command-input'
  import CommandItem from '@aziontech/webkit/command-item'
  import CommandList from '@aziontech/webkit/command-list'
  import CommandRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/command-root'
  import CommandSeparator from '@aziontech/webkit/command-separator'
  import SearchTrigger from '@aziontech/webkit/search-trigger'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <SearchTrigger @open="open = true" />

  <CommandRoot
    v-model:open="open"
    shortcut="meta+k"
  >
    <CommandInput placeholder="Search commands…" />
    <CommandList>
      <CommandGroup heading="Suggestions">
        <CommandItem value="deploy">Deploy Project</CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="new-app">Create Application</CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="settings">Go to Settings</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandSeparator />
      <CommandGroup heading="Commands">
        <CommandItem
          value="search"
          shortcut="meta+k"
          >Search everything</CommandItem
        >
        <CommandItem
          value="new-app-cmd"
          shortcut="meta+n"
          >New Application</CommandItem
        >
        <CommandItem
          value="toggle-theme"
          shortcut="meta+shift+l"
          >Toggle Theme</CommandItem
        >
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </CommandRoot>
</template>

examples.name: Grouped
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import CommandGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/command-group'
  import CommandInput from '@aziontech/webkit/command-input'
  import CommandItem from '@aziontech/webkit/command-item'
  import CommandList from '@aziontech/webkit/command-list'
  import CommandRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/command-root'
  import CommandSeparator from '@aziontech/webkit/command-separator'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    label="Open grouped palette"
    kind="primary"
    @click="open = true"
  />

  <CommandRoot
    v-model:open="open"
    shortcut=""
  >
    <CommandInput placeholder="Search commands…" />
    <CommandList>
      <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
        <CommandItem value="deploy">
          <template #prefix
            ><i
              class="pi pi-cloud-upload"
              aria-hidden="true"
          /></template>
          Deploy Project
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="new-app">Create Application</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandSeparator />
      <CommandGroup heading="Navigation">
        <CommandItem value="settings">
          <template #prefix
            ><i
              class="pi pi-cog"
              aria-hidden="true"
          /></template>
          Go to Settings
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="billing">Go to Billing</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandGroup heading="Account">
        <CommandItem value="profile">
          <template #prefix
            ><i
              class="pi pi-user"
              aria-hidden="true"
          /></template>
          View Profile
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="logout">Log Out</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </CommandRoot>
</template>
